policy: One finding per commit; one push after all three fixes and local checks. GitHub Actions remain disabled.

findings.title: Preserve focus when changing graph selectors
findings.change: Restore focus to the replacement key or resolved-instance selector when its change event rebuilds the graph, without moving focus from another control.
findings.regressionBefore: Inspector browser test fails: Changing the selected key must preserve keyboard focus; actual false.
findings.verification: pnpm test:browser:composition-inspector passes repeated key and reused-precomp instance changes, existing keyboard handle edits, desktop/phone flows, undo/save/watch and MP4 byte parity.
findings.testSetupRepair: Opened the advanced resolved-graph details panel before testing its visible selector; the initial hidden-control timeout was a test setup error.

findings.title: Preserve neighboring motion when replacing a segment with Bézier
findings.change: Materialize the native monotone smooth velocity on each endpoint's opposite side before clearing selected-segment smoothing; retain explicit velocities and existing handle ease. Spatial motion uses the native deterministic arc table, and color/vector tracks retain grouped channel velocities.
findings.regressionBefore: All 20 new cases fail because neighboring evaluated motion changes when the middle segment receives Bézier handles.
findings.verification: 35 focused curve/history tests pass, including 20 scalar/vector/color/spatial/signal cases over both smooth encodings and existing ease-only handles; neighboring subframe values agree within 1e-10, the edited segment changes, and undo/redo restores native source keys. TypeScript and full inspector desktop/phone/MP4 acceptance pass.

findings.title: Acquire export ownership before reading fixture assets
findings.change: Acquire the fixture export's busy guard before any awaited asset reads; wrap source parsing, asset capture and rendering in the same finally release.
findings.regressionBefore: With the first registered asset read paused, the second request reaches another asset read instead of returning 409; the new integration test fails with actual second asset read.
findings.verification: 20 focused integration tests pass. The real-export regression returns 200/409 with exactly one registered asset read; a separate failed-read case restores the asset and exports successfully, proving ownership is released. Existing save conflicts, independent-process locks, CLI, preview/watch and builder-key compilation remain green.

initialFinalCheckFailure: check:fast stopped at consistent-type-imports in the new export test; corrected the import() type annotation to a type-only namespace import.

reReview.standards: No substantive new findings or incomplete repairs.
reReview.spec: No substantive incomplete fixes or new spec issues.
reReview.method: Independent code-review skill sub-agents inspected all three final fixes before the last commit.

limitations: Full pnpm check was not rerun; frozen baselines were not regenerated.

delivery.strategy: One final normal push after the third finding commit
